title: Cosmic Wanderer Grid
description: A 4x4 grid of hand-drawn panels featuring a repeating female figure in a large starry hat and teal dress holding a celestial orb. The central cross-shaped area reveals a surreal landscape with purple fields, jagged mountains, two silhouetted figures, floating orbs, and a large red planet under a starry sky.
prompt: intricate ink drawing of a mysterious woman with long flowing hair wearing a wide-brimmed black hat covered in white stars and a teal patterned dress, she holds a transparent orb containing a red heart and white celestial patterns, arranged in a 4x4 grid with a central surreal landscape of purple flower fields, jagged mountains, two distant walking figures, floating spheres and a large red planet in a starry sky, whimsical and mystical atmosphere
